title: Exotic Car Detailing Studio
shortDescription: A high-end luxury automotive detailing booking and service studio website featuring an interactive package customizer, appointment scheduling, and dark glassmorphic styling.
overview: Exotic Car Detailing Studio is a bespoke web platform built for high-end luxury vehicle care, ceramic coating, and paint protection film (PPF) specialists. It pairs a dark, metallic luxury aesthetic with a dynamic service package configurator and a robust scheduling backend.
problem: Supercar owners require specialized care packages based on vehicle paint condition, clear coat thickness, and finish type. Standard static web pages failed to convey the premium craftsmanship or provide transparent custom quoting.
solution: Created an immersive web experience with dark glassmorphism, interactive package customization, dynamic price calculations based on vehicle class, and clear booking request flows.

features.title: Slot Booking Calendar
features.description: API syncs available studio bays, blocks conflicting dates, and provides instant booking holds.

features.title: Vehicle Service Catalog
features.description: Comprehensive guides on ceramic curing, clear bra maintenance, and multi-stage paint rejuvenation.

contributions: Engineered the full frontend experience with modern metallic dark styling, smooth hover states, and micro-interactions.
Developed backend RESTful endpoints for appointment slots, custom quote requests, and customer inquiries.
Integrated vehicle profiles and package configurations for seamless mobile selection.
Optimized media delivery and assets for lightning-fast mobile loading and 60 FPS transitions.

challenges.title: Preventing Concurrent Slot Overlap
challenges.challenge: Multiple simultaneous users attempting to reserve the same detailing bay created race conditions in booking submissions.
challenges.solution: Implemented atomic reservation checks with temporary holds that lock the bay while the customer completes details.

challenges.title: Maintaining 60 FPS Scroll with Dark Glassmorphism
challenges.challenge: Multiple blurred glassmorphism cards and large automotive visuals caused frame drops on mid-range devices.
challenges.solution: Applied CSS containment (`contain: paint`), reduced backdrop blur radiuses, and lazy-loaded offscreen media.
